Verified against the repository-pinned setup-uv SHA c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7:

  • The proposed range works. version-file: pyproject.toml reads [tool.uv].required-version, including >=0.12.18,<0.13. Selection defaults to the highest compatible version, so it floats within 0.12.x. Parser, resolution documentation.
  • An exact pin can coexist without duplication: put uv 0.12.22 once in .tool-versions, point every action’s version-file there, and retain the compatibility range in pyproject. These serve distinct purposes: selected CI version versus permitted runtime versions. Merely adding a uv dependency to pyproject would not override required-version; the parser prioritizes it. Supported version files, runtime constraint.
  • Simplest deterministic alternative: keep pyproject as the sole authority and set resolution-strategy: lowest; this selects 0.12.18, not 0.12.22. Resolver.
  • Avoid latest-known here: this pinned action’s bundled checksums stop at 0.12.17, below the proposed minimum. Checksum table.

No edits or builds performed.

Run this bounded check in the updated Python 3.15 environment:

JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE=ci uv run --no-sync pytest \
  tests/autodiff/test_jax.py \
  tests/autodiff/test_adapter_bridges.py \
  tests/autodiff/test_framework_physics.py::test_workflow_value_and_gradient \
  -k jax -q -ra

This exercises JIT, vmap, checkpointing, repeated VJPs, complex-gradient conventions, native callbacks, floating-point mode restoration, fresh-process worker initialization, and complete physics gradients. Check for executed passes, since missing JAX can produce skips.

Upgrade assessment: current PyPI JAX is 0.11.2, requiring matching jaxlib 0.11.2; jaxlib publishes a CPython 3.15 Linux x86-64 wheel. Its Python ≥3.12, NumPy ≥2.1 and SciPy ≥1.15 requirements fit the current project constraints. JAX metadata, jaxlib artifacts.

No source-level blocker found in the relevant changes:

  • 0.10 changes ShapeDtypeStruct.vma and CPU device names; this adapter uses only (shape, dtype) and device.platform.
  • 0.11 removes numerous jax.core internals; jax.core.Tracer remains exported, and it is the adapter’s only such dependency.
  • Changed empty initialization and tuple returns from broadcasting helpers do not intersect the inspected framework implementation. Pinned upstream changelog, retained Tracer export.

Existing CI already tests JAX 0.9.0 at the lower bound and newest allowed JAX on Python 3.13/3.14; the locked Python 3.15 lane supplies the missing interpreter check.

Read-only assessment; no edits, installs, builds, or tests performed.

  • Locked 0.2.0 requires Python >=3.12,<3.15 and has no CPython 3.15 wheels. Its sdist has the same restriction. Metadata.

  • Source builds use maturin >=1.12,<2 with locked Cargo dependencies; published wheels avoid that build. Source configuration.

Recommend 0.3.0 when refreshing to latest allowed; 0.2.1 is the smallest version change that resolves this specific incompatibility. Neither metadata check proves runtime compatibility.
